title: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus), Chapter 15
language: Greek (Codex Sinaiticus) / English (King James Version Apocrypha)
source: Codex Sinaiticus folio + transcription (codexsinaiticus.org) + King James Version Apocrypha (1611; 1769 text)
description: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) chapter 15. Manuscript page scan(s) from Codex Sinaiticus hosted by the Codex Sinaiticus Project, with the Project's verbatim transcription of the Greek and the English of King James Version Apocrypha (1611; 1769 text).
introduction:
This entry meets the strict three-criteria standard of the Theosis Library:

  1. Manuscript scan: The actual folio(s) of Codex Sinaiticus containing this chapter, from the Codex Sinaiticus Project (codexsinaiticus.org). Each section links to the specific folio holding its verses.
  2. Original text: The Codex Sinaiticus Project's verbatim transcription of the folio shown (uncial letters, lunate sigma, nomina sacra preserved).
  3. English translation: King James Version Apocrypha (1611; 1769 text), public domain, retrieved verbatim from ebible.org eng-kjv USFM (KJV with Apocrypha).

Numbering: Verse numbering of Sirach differs between the Greek manuscripts, Rahlfs, and the KJV in many chapters. Compare by content rather than by number.

translation.original_text: <sup>1</sup>ο φοβουμενοϲ κν · ποιηϲει αυτο ˙ και ο εγκρατηϲ του νομου · καταλημψεται αυτην · <sup>2</sup>και υπαντηϲει αυτω . ωϲ μητηρ ˙ και ωϲ γυνη παρθενιαϲ · προϲδεξεται αυτον · <sup>3</sup>ψωμιει αυτον · αρτον ϲυνεϲεωϲ · και υδωρ ϲοφιαϲ · ποτιει αυτον · <sup>4</sup>ϲτηριϲθηϲεται επ αυτον . και ου μη κλιϲθη · και επ αυτηϲ εφεξει · και ου μη καταιϲχυνθη · <sup>5</sup>και υψωϲει αυτον · παρα τουϲ πληϲιον αυτου ˙ και εν μεϲω εκκληϲιαϲ · ανοιξει το ϲτομα αυτου ·
translation.text: <sup>1</sup>He that feareth the Lord will do good, and he that hath the knowledge of the law shall obtain her. <sup>2</sup>And as a mother shall she meet him, and receive him as a wife married of a virgin. <sup>3</sup>With the bread of understanding shall she feed him, and give him the water of wisdom to drink. <sup>4</sup>He shall be stayed upon her, and shall not be moved; and shall rely upon her, and shall not be confounded. <sup>5</sup>She shall exalt him above his neighbours, and in the midst of the congregation shall she open his mouth.

translation.original_text: <sup>6</sup>ευφροϲυνην · και ϲτεφανον αγαλλιαματοϲ ευρηϲει και ονομα αιωνοϲ · κατακληρονομηϲει <sup>7</sup>ου μη καταλημψονται αυτην . ανοι αϲυνετοι ˙ και ανδρεϲ αμαρτωλοι . ου μη ϊδωϲιν αυτην <sup>8</sup>μακραν εϲτιν · υπερηφανιαϲ ˙ και ανδρεϲ ψευϲται · ου μη μνηϲωνται αυτηϲ ˙ <sup>9</sup>ουχʼ ωραιοϲ αινοϲ · αινοϲ εν ϲτοματι αμαρτωλου ˙ οτι ου παρα κυ · απεϲταλη ˙ <sup>10</sup>εν γαρ ϲοφια · ρηθηϲεται αινοϲ · και ο κϲ · ευοδωϲει αυτον ·
translation.text: <sup>6</sup>He shall find joy and a crown of gladness, and she shall cause him to inherit an everlasting name. <sup>7</sup>But foolish men shall not attain unto her, and sinners shall not see her. <sup>8</sup>For she is far from pride, and men that are liars cannot remember her. <sup>9</sup>Praise is not seemly in the mouth of a sinner, for it was not sent him of the Lord. <sup>10</sup>For praise shall be uttered in wisdom, and the Lord will prosper it.

translation.original_text: <sup>11</sup>μη ειπηϲ · οτι δια κν απεϲτη ˙ α γαρ εμιϲηϲεν . ου ποιηϲειϲ ˙ <sup>12</sup>μη ειπηϲ · αυτοϲ με επλανηϲεν ˙ ου γαρ χριαν εχει · ανδροϲ αμαρτωλου · <sup>13</sup>παν βδελυγμα · εμιϲηϲεν ο κϲ · και ουκ εϲτιν αγαπητον · τοιϲ φοβουμενοιϲ αυτον ˙ <sup>14</sup>αυτοϲ εξ αρχηϲ · εποιηϲεν ανον ˙ και αφηκεν αυτον · εν χιρι διαβουλιου αυτου · <sup>15</sup>εαν θεληϲηϲ ϲυντηρηϲειϲ εντολαϲ ˙ και πιϲτιν ποιηϲαι · ευδοκιαϲ ·
translation.text: <sup>11</sup>Say not thou, It is through the Lord that I fell away: for thou oughtest not to do the things that he hateth. <sup>12</sup>Say not thou, He hath caused me to err: for he hath no need of the sinful man. <sup>13</sup>The Lord hateth all abomination; and they that fear God love it not. <sup>14</sup>He himself made man from the beginning, and left him in the hand of his counsel; <sup>15</sup>If thou wilt, to keep the commandments, and to perform acceptable faithfulness.

translation.original_text: <sup>16</sup>παρεθηκεν ϲοι · πυρ και υδωρ · ου εαν θεληϲ · εκτενιϲ την χειρα ϲου · <sup>17</sup>εναντι ανων · η ζωη και ο θανατοϲ · και ο εαν ευδοκηϲη · δοθηϲεται αυτω ˙ <sup>18</sup>οτι πολλη ϲοφια του κυ · ϊϲχυροϲ εν δυναϲτια · και βλεπων τα παντα ˙ <sup>19</sup>και οι οφθαλμοι αυτου . επι τουϲ φοβουμενουϲ αυτον · και αυτοϲ επιγνωϲεται · παν εργον ανθρωπων ˙ <sup>20</sup>ουκ ενετιλατο ουδενι · αϲεβειν ˙ και ουκ εδωκεν ανεϲιν · ουδενι αμαρτανιν ˙
translation.text: <sup>16</sup>He hath set fire and water before thee: stretch forth thy hand unto whether thou wilt. <sup>17</sup>Before man is life and death; and whether him liketh shall be given him. <sup>18</sup>For the wisdom of the Lord is great, and he is mighty in power, and beholdeth all things: <sup>19</sup>And his eyes are upon them that fear him, and he knoweth every work of man. <sup>20</sup>He hath commanded no man to do wickedly, neither hath he given any man licence to sin.
